material_findings.boundary: T4 canonical exclusion and evidence provenance
material_findings.title: START fallback is time/number correlation, not exact attempt binding
material_findings.mechanism: A tokenless record binds when a START line has pgid equal to the newly assigned SESSION and a UTC-second stamp lexically greater than or equal to SPAWN_TS. An earlier legitimate START in the same UTC second compares equal, and a future-dated stale line also passes. Exclusive locking does not encode subsecond ordering or prevent later numeric session reuse.
material_findings.trigger: A stale readable shared record remains because the current attempt never adopts a runner or fails to replace START; the stale line has an equal-or-later second stamp and the same numeric PGID as the newly selected SESSION.
material_findings.consequence: runner_truth can import stale released/final/unpreserved/cleanup facts, causing a stale-derived dead hold and false attempt evidence. The direction is generally exclusion-conservative but exact provenance and truthful evidence are not established.
material_findings.control_gap: P3b truncates the stale file before proving positive START recognition; P3a uses a deliberately old stamp. Neither rejects the admitted equality/future stale cases.
material_findings.closure_required: Publish and require an unguessable current-attempt value, preferably the inherited lease token, in the earliest checked runner START record, or use a checked per-attempt record path. Fresh dual exact source review is required.
